'''Ignitoad''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Lickflicker]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ignitoad's breath is like a slow, churning current of volcanic heat, scorching the earth beneath. The flames that devour Ignitoad's enemies don't come from rage, however, but rather an attempt to keep the ambient temperature just right."

Ignitoad is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
